title: Word and Number Page Numbers

illustrates.quote: Words preceding page numbers are changed to an appropriate uppercase letter, e.g., change Reference 1 to R1. Note this change on the Transcriber's Notes page.

blocks.features: Five-row reference table; column 1 the original print word/number label, column 2 its abbreviated-and-combined form per 1.13.1.d.

braille.notes: Reference table (not a real 40-cell page): braille transcriptions of column 2 -- ,r#a / a,r#a / ,r#a-#f / a,r#a-#f / ,r#a-a,r#f -- in the same row order as print.blocks[0].rows. Recorded here for evidence; lines left empty since this is not a formatted braille page (see example-1-12's identical treatment).

resolution: Both runs agree on content. Same treatment as example-1-12: a reference table, not a real page, so braille.lines is left empty and the braille strings recorded in braille.notes; F-48 applies here too.
